ex.t: 在持续了一个世纪的激烈讨论之后,冈特放下了他的电话并发动了汽车.

ex.s: After a heated discussion that lasted for what seemed like a century, Gunter put his phone down and started the car.
ex.t: 在持续了一个世纪的激烈讨论之后,冈特放下了他的电话并发动了汽车.

ex.s: Why did BART start the kiosk program?
ex.t: 为什么BART启动"亭子计划"?.

ex.s: The Chinese Ministry of Agriculture finds that between 2005 – when the government   68   (start) a soil – testing program   69   gives specific fertilizer recommendations to farmers – and 2011, fertilizer use dropped by 7.7 million tons.
ex.t: 中国农业部发现,从2005年 — — 政府68(启动)土壤测试计划69(向农民提出具体的化肥建议)到2011年,化肥使用量下降了770万吨。

ex.s: C． start the smoke detector in a fire
ex.t: C.在火灾中启动烟雾探测器

ex.s: Then it starts all over again the next month.
ex.t: 后于次月复开.

ex.s: Carducci believes developing such a sense of belonging starts with small talk.

ex.s: I tried to turn on my brain but the engine just wouldn't start.” I should say my name, of course.
ex.t: 我试图打开我的大脑,但引擎没有启动。” 当然,我应该说我的名字。

defs.def: to begin to exist; to make sth begin to exist （使）出现；发起；创办；开办

ex.s: She started the Ladybug Foundation, an organization aiming at getting rid of homelessness.
ex.t: 她创办了Ladybug基金会,这是一个旨在摆脱无家可归状况的组织.

ex.s: Last year, the couple’s daughter started a GoFundMe to help cover the costs of some materials and tools.

defs.def: to begin a journey; to leave 出发；动身；起程

ex.s: Let’s get started by checking out Student Guide for your academic journey!
ex.t: 校对:Soup

defs.def: to begin to move in a particular direction 起身走向；向 … 而去
to begin, or to begin sth such as a career, in a particular way that changed later 以 … 起步（或起家）；起初是

ex.s: Farber, a graduate of Colorado State University, started out as a more conventional veterinarian.
ex.t: 法伯是科罗拉多州立大学的毕业生,起初是比较传统的兽医.

ex.s: I guess I was better than the others, for Miss Chevalier asked a while later, “Addie, I was wondering if you would recite the whole poem to the Saturday evening’s club.” She said a famous professor was going to give a lecture about the poet, and a presentation of that poem would be a fresh way to start.
ex.t: 我想,我比其他人好,因为谢瓦利埃小姐后来问道 : “ 艾蒂,我想知道你是否会向周六晚会的俱乐部朗诵整首诗。 ”她说,一位著名的教授将要为诗人讲课,介绍这首诗将是新的开端。

defs.def: to begin from a particular place, amount or situation （从 … ）开始；（由 … ）起

ex.s: "I often send postcards to family and friends." he says to China Daily, "but you can imagine that after a while, you never receive as many as you send, and you realize that not everyone is into it   32   ” Seeking other like-minded souls, however, Paulo started looking in a somewhat unlikely place: online.
ex.t: "我经常给家人和朋友寄明信片",他对"中国日报"说,"但你可以想象,过了一段时间,你从未收到你寄来的那么多,你意识到不是每个人都喜欢它32",然而,寻找其他志同道合的灵魂,保罗开始在某种程度上不太可能的地方寻找:在线.

defs.def: to move suddenly and quickly because you are surprised or afraid 突然一惊

ex.s: On a summer midnight, my parents and I had just___16___ a long flight and started to walk through the empty airport when I saw a passenger suddenly fall to the ground.
ex.t: 暑假午夜,我和父母刚开了一架长途航班,在看到一名乘客突然倒在地上时,开始穿过空机场。

defs.def: （给出首要理由）首先，第一

ex.s: But now is the time to set the record straight, which starts with questioning the idea that all social comparison is unhealthy.
ex.t: 但是现在是时候把记录理直气壮了,这首先要质疑一种观点,即所有的社会比较都是不健康的.

ex.s: In part one, I describe the philosophical foundations of digital minimalism, starting with an examination of the forces that are making so many people’s digital lives increasingly intolerable, before moving on to a detailed discussion of the digital minimalism philosophy.
ex.t: 在第一部分中，我描述了数字极简主义的哲学基础，首先考察了使许多人的数字生活越来越难以忍受的力量，然后详细讨论了数字极简主义哲学。

defs.def: at the beginning 起初；开始时

ex.s: What was a problem facing Jaramillo at the start of the program?
ex.t: Jaramillo在节目开始时遇到什么问题?

ex.s: How was Detrinidad’s business when it started?
ex.t: Detrinidad的生意开始时如何?

ex.s: ●Set a starting time.

defs.def: to begin to move 开始活动；动身
to begin happening; to begin doing sth 进行（或开展）起来
to begin by doing or being sth 首先进行；一开始是

ex.s: And at first it is, says Abby Jaramillo, who with another teacher started Urban Sprouts, a school garden program at four low-income schools.
ex.t: 一开始,艾比·贾拉米略说,他和另一位老师一起,在四个低收入学校开办了一个学校花园计划(Urban Sprouts).

ex.s: Though wastED received enthusiastic reviews, it was designed from the start as a short-lived experiment; Blue Hill has since returned to its regular menu.
ex.t: 虽然WASTED获得了热烈的评价，但它从一开始就被设计成一个短暂的实验； Blue Hill此后又回到了常规菜单。

defs.def: to make sb begin doing sth 使开始（做某事）

ex.s: The problem comes when you start doing too much complaint-based humor.
ex.t: 问题是当你开始做太多 投诉的幽默。

ex.t: 我开始尽我所能帮助他们建设一个小(10). 最重要的是,我开始像(11)一样对待他们. 当夏天,当其他队伍享受他们的(12)时,我们天天相遇,(13)通过并踢踢足球.

ex.t: 采访者:你刚上高中时有什么帮助?

ex.t: 例如,为了了解“Lisa在上高中时发现什么最有帮助?” 问题的答案,你会寻找“帮助”和“上高中”的关键词。

defs.def: to begin to do sth, especially in business or work 开始从事，着手（某工作）；从业

ex.s: In the____36____ (seven) grade,I started volunteering at the Monterey Bay Aquarium in California.
ex.t: 在36 (七)年级,我开始在加利福尼亚州的蒙特里湾水族馆做志愿工作。

ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 这需要15分钟的防晒霜才能开始工作,那么你的皮肤就有足够的时间吸收一天的维生素D.

ex.s: If you can start the conversation with a question other than “What do you do for a living?", you'll be able to get a lot more interesting conversation out of whomever it is you're talking to. ____37 ___. it can bring in "I have this old, broken-down vehicle" or "I rode the bus with these crazy people who were laughing at silly jokes in the back." It just opens up conversation.
ex.t: 如果您可以用“您做什么工作？”以外的问题开始对话，您将能够从与您交谈的人那里获得更多有趣的对话。____ 37 ___。它可以带来“我有这辆破旧的旧车”或“我和这些疯狂的人一起乘坐公共汽车，他们在后面嘲笑愚蠢的笑话。“这只是开启了对话。

ex.s: Starting a business.

defs.def: to have a particular intention when you begin sth 最初想要；起先打算
the point at which sth begins 开头；开端

ex.s: Dr Nieca Goldberg, a spokeswoman for the American Heart Association, says Levine's findings are a great start.
ex.t: 美国心脏协会的发言人尼卡·戈德伯格博士(Dr Nieca Goldberg)说莱文的发现是一个伟大的开端.

ex.s: What changes offered a new start to the author after his family moved? （no more than 15 words）

ex.s: （1）The passage starts with the story of Cervantes to show that     ．
ex.t: （ 1 ）段落以塞万提斯的故事开头，以此表明。

defs.def: the act or process of beginning sth 开始

ex.s: When he got older, John started to wonder if this process could be used to clean up the messes people were making.
ex.t: 当他长大了,约翰开始怀疑这个过程是否可以用来清理人们制造的混乱.

defs.def: the opportunity that you are given to begin sth in a successful way 起始优势；良好的基础条件

ex.s: Trainees also get a good start on their Wilderness Survival badge as they learn about water- and land-survival through designed tasks and their search and rescue of “downed” pilot.
ex.t: 受训人员通过设计任务和搜救“独资”飞行员,了解水和土地生存情况,因此,他们的“野生生存”徽章也有一个良好的开端。

ex.s: Start Point: Scratoes Bridge
ex.t: 起始点: 板球桥

defs.def: the place where a race begins 起点

ex.t: 我看着大卫和其他选手一起上到起点

ex.s: Jordan said that no matter how it ends, it starts with hope.
ex.t: 约旦说,无论结局如何,都以希望为起点。

defs.def: an amount of time or distance that sb has as an advantage over other people at the beginning of a race 起跑的提前量（时间或距离）

ex.s: That said, with a bang of the starting gun, I would dive into the cold water with all my strength and swim to the other side of the pool as fast as I could, only to find that the other swimmers slid past me.
ex.t: 说到这里,一枪一响,我就会用我所有的力气潜入冷水中,尽我所能游到游泳池的另一边,只为了发现其他游泳运动员从我身边滑过.

ex.s: For Cruse, what started out as a way to kill time has now developed into a way to make a difference in the heart of a child.
ex.t: 对于克鲁斯来说,最初作为消磨时间的一种方式,现在已经发展成了一种在孩子的心脏中有所改变的方法.

ex.s: Register online or fill out a Group Play Registration Form with multiple date and start time options.
ex.t: 在线注册或填写带有多个日期和起始时间选项的团体游戏注册表.

ex.s: Three years ago, schools in Edina, Minnesota, changed the start time from 7:25 am to 8:30 am.
ex.t: 三年前,明尼苏达州Edina的学校将开学时间从早上7点25分改为早上8点30分.

ex.s: And when people started ___9___, that gave me a boost of confidence.
ex.t: 当人们开始 9  , 这给了我信心的提升。

ex.t: Cobb为她的派对,开始请会议组织者邀请她讲 42  她可以远程讲;大约3/4的 43  时间,他们同意.

defs.def: a race or competition that sb has taken part in （参加的）比赛

ex.s: At the start of this year, foreigners living in Italy amounted to 4.56 million of a total population of 60.6 million, or 7.5 percent, with immigrants’ children accounting for an even larger percentage of births in Italy.
ex.t: 今年年初,居住在意大利的外国人在6,060万总人口中达到456万人,占7.5%,移民子女在意大利出生的比例更大。
